_comment: Fault-model calibration derived from the live DeFCoN network via the deftrack explorer. OBSERVED fields are measured; DERIVED/ASSUMED fields are modeled from the observations and are labeled as such. Source: deftrack MongoDB (defcon_explorer), collections masternodeevents + networknoiseobservations, 14-day window ending 2026-08-10.

provenance.note: noise-signal fields come from ~15 monitored nodes; masternodeevents cover the full registered set

network._enabled_note: The 76 low is a transient PoSe-drop artifact; the design regime is the >=150 healthy floor.

fault_model._derivation: Two-regime (quiet vs cascade) correlated failure model. The network is NOT in independent-offline steady state: PoSe/DKG failures cluster into cascades (13.4% of hours carry pose activity; daily ban spikes up to 246 vs a ~1.5 median). Independent-offline sims understate real failure; these parameters drive a correlated model instead.
fault_model._online_rate_note: DERIVED/ASSUMED: quiet 0.92 reflects normal MN availability; cascade 0.60 anchors to the report's severe single-domain (40%) correlated case and the observed cascade behaviour. Treat as a modeled band, not a direct measurement.
fault_model._partition_note: Fraction of the active quorum's members that land on the larger side of a network partition; 0.5 = worst case for dual-signing.
